title: Aspect: Wyvern Talons, the stoop
note: Design doc §2: the Wyvern's claws come from hind talons on dives. It pays with position: first it leaps. Then a Claw from the air stoops on a grounded target anywhere within Far, lands on the ground at Melee, and swipes both ways. Brine strafes, but the two-sided swipe catches it. Landed, the Wyvern is in Bite range.
